name: Tata Communications Limited
summary: Tata Communications Limited operates as a communications technology company worldwide. It offers voice and data transmission services, internet connectivity services, and other value-added services, such as unified conferencing and collaboration services, managed hosting, mobile global roaming and signaling services, transponder lease, television uplinking and other managed services, data center colocation services, network management and support, and other related services.
